sentence: an outer glazed archway with four marble 华表, a moon-river bridge, 致孚殿 Zhifu Dian of three bays, three archways, a five-bay gate 安佑门 behind three marble bridges, well pavilions and waiting rooms, two double-roofed stele pavilions, and the nine-bay hall 安佑宫 with double-eaved hip-gable roof in yellow glazed tile, holding the portraits of Kangxi (centre), Yongzheng (east) and later emperors (E1556, S05; E1560, S360).
note: S05 j81:19b-21b gives: the glazed archway with stone 华表 left and right (左右石華表各一), three more archways ringed to its south, east and west, the moon-river bridge south of them, the three-bay 致孚殿 to the south-east facing west, the five-bay gate 安佑门 facing south with three white marble bridges before it, a well pavilion and five-bay waiting rooms on each side, and inside the double-eaved nine-bay hall with five-bay side halls, a stele pavilion and a burner pavilion each side. The order in the draft (three archways after 致孚殿) follows E1564 and is not S05's. Four 华表 come from Malone (E1561) and S980; S05 reads as two. Yellow tile and hip-gable from E1560. 中龕聖祖, 左龕世宗 (left = east): held.
fix: S05 walks it as a glazed archway with stone 华表 (four by Malone and the PKU record, E1561, S980), three more archways round it to the south, east and west, a moon-river bridge south of them, the three-bay 致孚殿 Zhifu Dian to the south-east facing west, the five-bay gate 安佑门 Anyou Men facing south behind three white marble bridges, a well pavilion and five-bay waiting rooms on each side, and inside the gate the double-eaved nine-bay hall 安佑宫 with five-bay side halls, a stele pavilion and a burner pavilion on each side (S05 j81:19b-21b, E1556). The hall had a hip-and-gable roof in yellow glazed tile (E1560, S360) and held the portraits of Kangxi in the centre and Yongzheng on the east, later joined by others (E1556; E1560; E1564).
